biggest_catch: collabs.io is a brand-side, invite-only influencer campaign platform — brands must request access and it publishes no standard influencer rates — so there is no public creator program with concrete creator pay to verify.
catches: Collabs' official pages are written for brands: 'done for you' CPM/CPC influencer campaigns, with brands required to disclose annual revenue to request an invite.
The platform states it does not show standard influencer quotes — pricing is per-campaign and brand-side.
No public creator signup with published pay terms or concrete creator rates exists.
The catalog's 'formerly AspireIQ' label is not supported by official evidence; collabs.io presents as a separate brand-facing platform — rejected on its own merits regardless.

c1.evidence: collabs.io is a real company, but it is a brand-facing, invite-only platform — not an open creator program.

c2.evidence: No concrete creator pay figure or commission mechanic in official public terms; the platform does not publish standard influencer rates.

eligibility: Brands request invites to run campaigns; creators are sourced per campaign by the platform — no open public creator pay terms.
notes: Reviewed 2026-09-22: collabs.io's official pages (homepage and /cpm) describe brand-side influencer campaign services with invite-only access and no published standard influencer rates. Whether or not it has any historical connection to AspireIQ, it fails the user's bar on its own: no concrete official creator pay. Rejected on the same bar as Insense, Trend, AspireIQ, Creator.co, and Tribe.
